name: Bug report or missed favourite

title: ''
labels: bug
assignees: ''
---

## Problem

What happened, and what did you expect? For selection feedback, identify the
chosen frame and the preferred frame or acceptable alternatives.

## Reproduction

Include the command, relevant options, and the smallest useful reproduction.
Remove API keys and private paths. State whether this used local selection,
a local judge, or a cloud judge.

## Environment

- FotoSort version or commit:
- OS and Python version:
- Camera and file type, if relevant:
- Judge provider/model and relevant settings, if used (no credentials):

## Evidence

Include relevant report rows, errors, and whether the judge saw the preferred
frame. Downsized examples are optional; share only photos you can make public.
For file-operation problems, describe which originals, companions, and outputs
were involved.

## Acceptance criteria

Describe the observable behavior that would resolve this issue and how it can
be checked. Distinguish a logic fix from an improvement needing real-photo
evaluation.
